classification: Functional full-array comparison; no cross-study timing claims
scope: All registered historical cases, original prompts/caps, and every returned lane array. Serial request journals are checked against the full stdout arrays. Clone journals contain counts and metrics only; clone arrays are validated from complete stdout and its token hashes. Runtime bundle artifacts are read back and checked against receipts. CPU/GPU/operator test binaries occupied shared build paths subsequently rebuilt for a distinct source: their original registration, successful receipts and unchanged before/after hashes are retained, without asserting those build paths still contain the original binaries. This functional comparison does not establish sampling equivalence, model quality, generalization or a throughput effect. Old results remain unchanged.
